content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-59. - Reserved.
content.summary:
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4890
, § 5, adopted February 10, 2025, repealed § 70-59, which pertained to appointment
               rates upon transfer, promotion, demotion or voluntary reassignment and derived from
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023.
